title: Baingan
overview: It's a Harynani movie. The plot centers on a frustrated landlord named Radheshyam (played by Jagbir Rathee) who is trying to collect rent from a stubborn and somewhat muscular tenant, Dilbaag (Vishal Saini). When Radheshyam demands his money, Dilbaag refuses to pay and instead disrespects him by hurling the word "baingan" at him.
